HEEWON STYLE: Korean webtoon / anime figures with clean ink-line faces and hands, bodies and silk PAINTED with loaded brushstrokes and dry-brush drag in 3–4 value planes, inside a hand-painted watercolor-and-oil world; interiors and night are a Baroque tenebrist old-master canvas (Caravaggio, La Tour, Rembrandt) — broken-colour brushwork, glazed umber-to-black darks, sfumato, impasto on the brightest highlight, canvas grain over everything. Simple minimal iconic layout: one device, one or two subjects on the thirds, at least half the frame quiet negative space. Movie tenebrism at full strength: 75% of the frame deep painted shadow, ONE hard practical key close to the subject raking across what the camera sees, near-white highlights beside inky black, long shadows. 2.5D: every fold and plate protrudes, lit side one opaque stroke, shadow a thin umber glaze. Three planes: dark out-of-focus foreground shape, razor-sharp midground subject, background dissolving into wash with painted bokeh discs. Dusk, night, storm or pre-dawn — never flat daylight. Faces stay drawn webtoon faces, never photoreal; never a 3D render or smooth airbrush. Character hex only as real light (lamp, shaft, specular), never a glow aura or halo. Face and garments match the attached portraits; new dramatic body every still. One of each named person. Real Korean architecture and ground. Composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop — nothing important at the top or bottom edge. No text, no writing, no watermark.
